subject: Osiris integration: evidence liaison & transfer onboarding
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@osiris-sec.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Osiris integration: evidence liaison & transfer onboarding

Hi Tessa & Marcus,

Thanks for the intro call yesterday — we're excited to get Osiris plugged into Redwood's evidence flow. Attached is a first-pass scope matrix (osiris_scope_matrix.xlsx) that maps evidence types (logs, config snapshots, vulnerability scans, pen test reports) to preferred transfer channels. A few quick notes: 

- We prefer S3 presigned PUTs for bulk artifacts, SFTP for legacy partners, and a push-based GRC API for automated proofs-of-coverage.
- Encryption: everything at-rest must be AES-256; we can sign objects client-side if you need additional assurance.
- Retention: default 90 days for artifacts unless otherwise negotiated.

Questions for you:
1) Do you have a preferred S3 bucket naming convention and cross-account access pattern (IAM role vs. presigned)?
2) Any redaction/PII process we need to follow before we ship reports?
3) Who will be Redwood's evidence liaison (single point of contact for day-to-day transfers)?

If it helps, Priya (cc'd) will be our technical integrator and can take a short runbook once we agree on the channel.

Cheers,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Integrations, Osiris Security
osiris-sec.com

Attachment: osiris_scope_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 28KB)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@osiris-sec.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@osiris-sec.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Osiris integration: evidence liaison & transfer onboarding

Liam — great summary, thanks. Short answers inline: 

1) S3 pattern: we use a dedicated cross-account bucket per partner under redwood-evidence-partners/partner-id=osiris/. Preferred pattern is cross-account IAM role with PutObject permissions for uploads and a lifecycle policy applied by us. We prefer role assumption for auditability. I'll attach a short instruction PDF (redwood_s3-instruction.pdf).

2) Redaction: our policy requires the partner to remove customer-identifying PII from pen test reports unless the customer has approved a full-report transfer. We can accept redacted PDFs + a metadata manifest with hash values.

3) Evidence liaison: that'll be me for the first 30 days (onboarding), then Marcus will take over ongoing operations.

Proposed next steps (quick MAP):
- Liam/Priya: confirm you can assume the cross-account role (we'll send trust policy) — target by 11/24.
- Osiris: upload a sample pen test report (redacted) to the presigned flow or SFTP so we can validate ingestion — target by 11/25.
- Redwood: share transfer runbook and access controls doc — done (see links).

If you prefer a short working session to walk through the S3 role and manifest format, we're available tomorrow 11/23 9-11 PST.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Sr Partner Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_s3-instruction.pdf (application/pdf, 56KB)

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@osiris-sec.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@osiris-sec.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Osiris integration: evidence liaison & transfer onboarding

Thanks Tessa — we can do role assumption, but a couple of constraints: 

- Our security team requires signed transfer agreements for any external bucket writes. Can you send a minimal evidence access agreement we can route to legal?
- We produce full, non-redacted pen test artifacts internally; we will produce redacted variants on request. For the sample upload, we'll send a redacted PDF + a manifest.

Also, small ask: what's Redwood's expected SLA for ingestion and validation (i.e., once we PUT an object, how long until it shows as 'available' in your GRC console)? That will determine our automation retries.

Would Thursday 11/25 10:00 PST work for a 30-min sync to walk through the role and manifest?

Best,
Priya Rao
Integrations Engineer, Osiris Security

---
On Mon, Nov 22, 2026 at 09:14 AM Liam O'Connor <liam@osiris-sec.com> wrote:
> [see previous message]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@osiris-sec.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@osiris-sec.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Osiris integration: evidence liaison & transfer onboarding

Priya — quick answers from infra/ops: 

- Ingestion SLA: once an object is PUT to the agreed bucket and the manifest is present, our pipeline typically indexes within 5-10 minutes; full validation (schema + hash verification) is usually under 1 hour unless manual redaction checks are required.
- Trust policy: Tessa will share a minimal cross-account role trust doc. We'll also provide CloudTrail proof-of-write events for audit.

I'm attaching a draft evidence access agreement we use with tier-2 partners. Legal should be able to run a quick track on a partner addendum.

Two items for the sync:
1) Sample manifest spec (we'll publish a short example in the call).
2) Confirmation on retention/auto-delete rules per artifact type.

Looking forward to the call tomorrow.

Marcus Lin
Head of Platform Trust, Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence_access_agreement.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 18KB)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@osiris-sec.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@osiris-sec.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T10:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Osiris integration: evidence liaison & transfer onboarding

Thanks Marcus — that SLA is reasonable. Legal reviewed the draft and asked for two clarifications in section 3.2 (retention override by customer) and section 7.1 (incident notification window). We've annotated the doc and sent back a redline; please let me know the best place to upload the redline (DocuSign or Confluence?).

We can do 11/25 10:00 PST — Priya and I will join. See you on the call.

Liam

> Attachment: osiris-draft-redlines.pdf (application/pdf, 42KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@osiris-sec.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@osiris-sec.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Osiris integration: evidence liaison & transfer onboarding

Great sync today — summary and follow-ups: 

Summary: 
- Osiris will assume cross-account role and upload a sample redacted pen test report + manifest.
- Redwood will validate ingestion within our 1-hour SLA and share CloudTrail proof-of-write for the sample.
- Legal redlines received; Redwood legal will review sections 3.2 and 7.1 and propose final language by 11/29.

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Liam / Priya (Osiris): upload sample artifact to the test bucket and paste presigned URL in this thread — ETA 11/25 EOD.
- Tessa (Redwood): circulate final trust policy JSON and the manifest example — ETA 11/24 (sent).
- Marcus (Redwood): run the sample through the ingestion pipeline and confirm validation results + CloudTrail events — ETA 11/25 EOD.
- Legal (both sides): finalize evidence access agreement redlines — ETA 11/29.

Notes: Please include the manifest as a small JSON file with: artifact_type, artifact_name, sha256, redaction_status, originating_customer (redacted_id). We'll publish the schema in Confluence (link above).

Thanks all — good momentum.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
